rationale: The expression is internally consistent with the stated "policy-fit" story, but its long leg explicitly includes equity issuers with below-industry interest coverage — precisely the low-profitability equity-issuer group that both the net-share-issuance and profitability anomalies say underperforms — and the debt-issuance-with-weak-coverage arm largely reproduces the archived "Debt Issue Coverage Strain" and "Profit-Conditioned Equity Preference" constructs.

This is the archived "Cash-Strained Equity Recycling" template with dltis/dltr substituted for sstk/prstkc, and MIN(|dltis|,|dltr|) is largely a mechanical proxy for revolver/short-maturity debt turnover, so the interaction risks collapsing into the already-known low-operating-cash-flow effect rather than adding rollover-risk content.

The TS_MIN "profitability floor" is a defensible refinement and the sign logic is coherent, but this is the fourth pass at the same short-debt-share × weak-profitability family (vol, margin trend, ROA level) that has produced uniformly weak evidence, and TS_MIN(ROA,5) is close to a plain low-profitability indicator.

This is essentially the archived "Debt-Funded Buyback Gap" with sstk added to the financing leg and dvt added to the payout leg — a broadening of a construct that already failed on the portfolio side (ls_talpha −0.38) without any diagnosis of why it failed.

Bounding is a legitimate response to the fmb/alpha disagreement in "Dilution-Adjusted Operating Improvement," but it remains the same ΔROA-versus-share-growth construct, and normalizing by the sum of absolute values both discards economic magnitude and amplifies noise for firms where both components are near zero (ratio jumps to ±1).

It recombines pieces of two archived signals, but the recombination is a genuinely discriminating test — whether the equity-recycling effect is driven by earnings quality rather than cash-flow level — with a consistent expression, sign, and coverage.
